# News24

> > News24 delivers South African entertainment news, celebrity interviews, and cultural stories with a focus on local talent and productions.

News24 covers entertainment and celebrity news with emphasis on South African actors, productions, and cultural narratives. The site features in-depth interviews and profiles of entertainment industry figures.

## Key Topics

- South African entertainment
- Celebrity interviews
- Wiseman Zitha
- Giyani: Land of Blood
- Acting and fashion
- Limpopo
- Entertainment news
- Career profiles
- Local productions
- South African actors
